description: This file contains the implementation of the RepoAdder class responsible for fetching, adding, and managing repositories in the FDroid app. It handles network operations, repository validation, and database updates related to repositories.

classes.name: AddRepoState
classes.description: Sealed class representing the various states of repository addition process.

classes.name: Fetching
classes.description: Represents the state when a repository is being fetched, including progress details.

classes.name: Adding
classes.description: Represents the state when a repository is being added.

classes.name: Added
classes.description: Represents the state after a repository has been successfully added.

classes.name: AddRepoError
classes.description: Represents an error state during repository addition, with specific error types.

classes.name: FetchResult
classes.description: Sealed class representing the result of fetching a repository, including new or existing repo/mirror states.

classes.name: RepoAdder
classes.description: Main class responsible for fetching, validating, and adding repositories, managing network and database operations.

methods.name: fetchRepository
methods.description: Starts the process of fetching a repository from a URL with an optional proxy.

methods.name: fetchRepositoryInt
methods.description: Internal suspend function that performs the actual repository fetching and validation.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during repository fetching by updating the state.

methods.name: fetchRepo
methods.description: Fetches the repository from a URI, trying v2 format first, then falling back to v1.

methods.name: getFetchResult
methods.description: Determines the fetch result type based on the fetched repository and existing database entries.

methods.name: addFetchedRepository
methods.description: Finalizes adding a fetched repository into the database, updating or inserting as needed.

methods.name: abortAddingRepo
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing repository fetch/add process.

methods.name: addArchiveRepo
methods.description: Adds an archive version of a repository.

methods.name: hasDisallowInstallUnknownSources
methods.description: Checks if the user restrictions disallow installing from unknown sources.

methods.name: getTempRepo
methods.description: Creates a temporary Repository object for fetching.
